opener_episode.title: Turning Art into a Business: Photographer to Business Entity
opener_episode.guest: unverified (confirm name on the episode page before sending)
opener_episode.why: The closest recent episode to Avery's expertise (art as a business), so the opener leads straight into how artist careers are built into brands. If the guest name can't be confirmed, fall back to 'How Cordae Quietly Built His Powerhouse Stock Portfolio' (2026-09-26, verified) and pivot from entertainer portfolios to art as an asset.

angles.headline: Art as generational wealth: building a collection around Black artists
angles.pitch: Avery was an early champion of Hebru Brantley and Jammie Holmes and can explain how collectors spot artists before the market does, and what buying early looks like.
angles.builds_on: EYL's prior art-investing coverage (EYL #129 w/ Troy Carter; 'Art Investing for Beginners' w/ Ingrid Best) and 'Turning Art into a Business' (Aug 2026)

angles.headline: How an artist becomes a brand: the Alec Monopoly playbook
angles.pitch: Avery developed Alec Monopoly into a global brand with sold-out exhibitions and major brand partnerships, a business-model breakdown of artist IP, licensing and collaborations.
angles.builds_on: Ownership/business-model breakdowns like 'Turning Art into a Business' and 'Shaq on Building a $400M Empire'

angles.headline: What celebrities and athletes really buy, and how to advise them
angles.pitch: Avery advises celebrities, athletes and high-net-worth clients on buying and investing in art, and built ArtLife.com into an eight-figure online gallery using his 'Click & Mortar' model.
angles.builds_on: Entertainer/athlete money episodes: Cordae's portfolio (Sept 26), NIL (Sept 28), Shaq (Aug 6); and the Miami migration episode (Aug 1) for a Miami-based angle

format: Video-first (YouTube ~1.67M subs, June 2026 third-party) plus audio on iHeart (The Black Effect / iHeartPodcasts). New York based; host-led interviews, mostly in-studio (remote policy unverified). Very high cadence: multiple uploads per week, mixing interviews with hosts' market/news episodes and EYL network content. Typical guests: founders, finance educators, rappers/athletes with business stories.
red_flags: Aug 2026 backlash over Rashad Bilal's Invest Fest comments (TheGrio, 2026-08-18); critics have accused EYL of 'unvetted guests', so expect credibility screening. Some feed items may be network/clip content rather than full guest interviews. No verified booking email.
notes: August 2026 titles and dates come from a search summary of Apple/podcast-directory listings and were not individually confirmed; the Cordae (9/26) and NIL (9/28) episodes were confirmed via iHeart/Podchaser results. Guest names for the NIL, art-business, Bronx-luxury and Miami-migration episodes are unverified. The Aug 1 'Miami Migration' episode is a useful secondary hook for a Miami-based guest.
